assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: source base-color surface texture for Bad Apple Hotel, an original darkly humorous gothic 2.5D game. No perspective, background margin, 3D object, scene, furniture, title, labels, symbols, magic or game UI. Uniform neutral diffuse illumination, no baked cast shadows, specular glare, center spotlight or vignette. Painterly material realism with restrained grain and broad mobile-readable detail, neither a photograph nor chunky pixel blocks. Matching repeat edges are a requirement; continue details naturally across them. Subject: a continuous expanse of aged medium-dark walnut floorboards, all running left to right. About twelve parallel rows of narrow planks. Each row has irregularly staggered butt joints with long plank lengths spanning roughly one-third to two-thirds of the image width; no four corners meet. Thin quiet brown seams, no gaps. Natural subdued grain with small varied knots, gentle worn satin finish, muted warm umber with soft gray-brown undertones. Several quiet grain variations with very similar brightness. The board field continues beyond all image edges; no perimeter border and no square parquet panels, framing strips, herringbone or decorative inset. Avoid strongly distinctive repeated damage marks. Material must read as the actual continuous wooden floor of an old hotel.

useRules: Continuous room/world texture coordinates; keep coherent plank direction per room.

Do not rotate random tiles or mix carpet designs in checkerboards. Assign a finish by room/corridor zone.
Carpet field images repeat in two directions. Binding repeats only along its horizontal axis; corners and ends use mesh UVs.
Spectral signs and arrows are separate procedural shapes, never baked into these images.
